changelog: Native Linux Desktop Edition: Official WebToApp Studio Pro for Ubuntu/Debian powered by WebKitGTK and Photino.NET
Universal Tri-Platform Builder on Linux: Ubuntu users can now package Windows (.exe), Google Play Android Studio, and Ubuntu (.deb) apps
Debian Package (.deb) & Portable Tarball (.tar.gz): 1-click install or portable execution on Ubuntu 20.04/22.04/24.04 and Debian 11/12
Cross-Platform Decoupling: WebToExe.Core multi-targeted to net8.0 and net8.0-windows with zero Electron bloat (~1.3 MB package)
Unified IPC Bridge: Frontend automatically bridges across WebView2 and Photino message pipelines
